Got a pocket, got a… Socket Full of Sunshine. ☀️🔌

New Jersey families are facing utility bills that rose nearly 17% last year. They need relief now.

That’s why we introduced the Socket Full of Sunshine Act.

The bill would make affordable, plug-in solar panels accessible to more households—while cutting red tape and protecting renters.

Eligible households could receive up to $1,000 in rebates, helping families harness the sun and save hundreds on their electric bills each year.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Concur in Senate Adt to House Adt to Senate Adt — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote, under suspension of the rules, was on accepting the Senate's latest changes to the bill after the chambers traded versions, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea accepts the Senate's version; a Nay opposes it.
